profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have been involved with web development since 1997 and game development since 1998. I currently specialize in object oriented PHP development. In my spare time I develop video games, iPhone applications, and custom web applications. Programming is both a hobby and passion of mine.

Specialties: php, c++, javascript, standards compliant html, OO design

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Developed and maintained software for Viacom Music and Entertainment (MTV, Logo, VH1, Comedy Central, Spike) websites.

positions.title: Web Operations Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for web related engineering and PHP development on several HFMUS properties including Elle.com, RoadAndTrack.com, CarAndDriver.com, and WomansDay.com.

volunteerExperiences.description: My wife and I volunteer at Husky House Inc., a 501c3 charitable animal rescue organization in Matawan, New Jersey. While we assist at some of the events and occasionally help out at the lodge, our primary contribution to the team was to rebuild their website www.huskyhouse.org from the ground up with a modern responsive design and we provide ongoing support.
